remote.note: A live demo endpoint pointing at one laptop. It may rotate; the repository runs the same nine tools locally with npm run mcp:http.

note: Captured from a real MCP session against src/mcp/server.js. The JSON below is what the server answered, unedited.

tools.name: cerrojo_politicas
tools.label: List the policies
tools.body: Caps, allowlist and the permitted token. Read only.

tools.name: cerrojo_simular_pago
tools.label: Simulate one payment
tools.body: ALLOW or DENY from the WDK policy engine, with the policy, the rule and the reason. Touches no network.

tools.name: cerrojo_correr_nomina
tools.label: Run a payroll
tools.body: CSV in, receipt out. Always dry-run: this server has no way to ask for live.

tools.name: cerrojo_estado_diario
tools.label: Today's counter
tools.body: How much of the daily cap is committed, and how much is left.

tools.name: cerrojo_recibo_de
tools.label: Re-read a receipt
tools.body: Any earlier run, by its id.

tools.name: cerrojo_saldo
tools.label: Treasury balance
tools.body: Read through toReadOnlyAccount(), an object with no send method on it.

tools.name: cerrojo_cotizar
tools.label: Quote a fee
tools.body: What a transfer would cost. A quote is not a permission.

tools.name: cerrojo_proponer_pago
tools.label: Propose a payment
tools.body: If the policies allow it, leaves a voucher for a person. Signs nothing.

tools.name: cerrojo_estado_vale
tools.label: Voucher status
tools.body: Proposed, approved, executed, denied, rejected or expired. Looking at a voucher does not move it.

absent.name: cerrojo_enviar
absent.body: No tool signs or sends. Not in dry-run, not with a flag, not at all.

absent.name: cerrojo_aprobar
absent.body: Approving exists only in the CLI, where a person types it. A prompt cannot pay itself.

transcript.title: The agent asks for 900 USDT

response.razon: Supera el tope por transferencia de 500000000 unidades base (500.000000 USDT).

transcript.reading: Refused by name, and the trace shows both rules that looked at it. No network was touched to say no.

transcript.title: It tries a stranger instead

response.razon: La suma del dia superaria el tope diario de 1500000000 unidades base (1500.000000 USDT).
response.nota: No se crea vale para una orden denegada. Cambia la orden, no la politica.

transcript.reading: The recipient is on the list and the amount is under the per-transfer cap — and it still fails, because 1,296 USDT already went out today. No voucher is created for a denied order.

transcript.title: Within every limit, it gets a voucher — not a payment

response.siguiente_paso: Una persona tiene que ejecutar en su terminal: cerrojo aprobar vale_2026-08-23T07-05-38-106Z_dd4fb7
response.nota: Este servidor no puede aprobar el vale. La aprobacion vuelve a pasar por las politicas, y sin --live --confirmo la ejecucion sigue siendo dry-run.

transcript.reading: The best outcome available to the agent is a voucher that expires in fifteen minutes, fingerprinted so the order cannot change between the proposal and the signature.
